purpose: Pre-art authored vocabulary and exact-art reuse inventory. Word-picture chapters remain closed until all targets have packaged images.
pronunciationAndFairnessNotes: Pronunciation basis is contemporary non-rhotic Southern British English.
branch and grass use /ɑː/ in the selected UK pronunciation. Their spelling grapheme a is retained, and the matching existing ar sound key is used for the spoken phoneme.
flower is excluded because its non-rhotic final unstressed vowel has no matching packaged sound key; snow is excluded because ow lacks a complete sound path here.

cheese is excluded because final s is /z/ and the available pure-sound inventory does not represent that voiced consonant. Ambiguous actions, people, and function words are excluded from picture-only targets.
Sound positions follow phoneme order. First/last questions use all eligible words. Middle questions use odd phoneme counts only; even-count words have no middle question.
Persisted selectedSounds are applied to every grapheme in each target and each picture decoy. There is no fallback to words outside the saved taught-sound set.
